name: berean-ffi-rn
description: berean-ffi (the Berean Rust core) for React Native, generated by uniffi-bindgen-react-native

scripts.ubrn:android: ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate --release && touch android/proguard-rules.pro
scripts.ubrn:generate: ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate --release --no-cargo && touch android/proguard-rules.pro
scripts.ubrn:clean: rm -rf android ios cpp build src/generated src/index.tsx src/Native*.ts *.podspec
